findings.evidence: Lines 60–92 use only pointwise equality, ranges, `IsLocallyFlat.homeomorph_comp`, and symmetry. `TauCeti/Geometry/Manifold/SmoothAmbientIsotopic/Basic.lean:66–73` already defines the same relation for arbitrary bundled smooth maps with a diffeotopy witness.
findings.fix: State these results first for `{f g : C^n⟮I, M; J, N⟯}` and `TauCeti.SmoothAmbientIsotopic f g` in the general `SmoothAmbientIsotopic` namespace; derive an embedding specialization only if coercion does not already make it directly usable.
findings.issue: `range_eq_image_of_diffeotopy`, `exists_range_eq_image`, `isLocallyFlat_of_smoothAmbientIsotopic`, and `isLocallyFlat_iff` never use the `SmoothEmbedding` structure, so the API excludes arbitrary smooth maps despite the same conclusions holding unchanged.

summary: All new results are unnecessarily restricted to bundled embeddings; their proofs use only the existing ambient-isotopy relation on arbitrary bundled smooth maps.
